summary: Fused Inkling rmsnorm_gelu kernel vs PyTorch reference within bf16 ulps: kernel numerics, below the model.

kernel_warmup/flashinfer_autotune is missing: compile-or-warm-up runs only the compile-size dummy run (8192, not profile), with no per-token-count autotune runs (8192, 128). fused-moe-config has no deferred-finalize fields.
EmbeddingGemma2 isn't modeled: no encoder-only sliding layers with window W+1, so no (512,512) impl window. get-model returns no per-layer structure.

--runner auto resolves to generate for Qwen2ForSequenceClassification (the code resolves pooling), so llm.classify fails 'only supported for pooling models'. serving-api llm.encode also reads raw config['runner']. Logits closeness is untranslatable.
qwen_vl_triton_warmup/_warm_vision and the Qwen3-VL architecture are missing: no pos-embed or rotary warm calls; the dummy run falls to llama forward.
LLM.encode(pooling_task=token_embed) on a pooling runner returns one output per prompt (8). Embedding closeness is untranslatable.

BertModel with runner pooling: the model gives attn_type decoder, seq_pooling_type null, prefix caching and chunked prefill supported. The code gives encoder_only, CLS (registry default), both unsupported. post-init reads pooling type from config.json; ModelsModelInfo (models-layers) lacks default_seq_pooling_type and attn_type.
